newsitem.title: USA: PP&L completes review at Susquehanna plant.
newsitem.headline: PP&L completes review at Susquehanna plant.

text.p: PP&L Resources Inc said on Friday that as the company completed its assessment of operations at the Susquehanna nuclear plant it found that two employees did not perform their duties "as expected."
The employees, a shift supervisor and a former shift supervisor, are no longer employed by the company, PP&L said.
Safety at the nuclear plant was not affected by their performance lapses and most tasks were completed" in accord with procedures."
The company said it has notified the Nuclear Regulatory Commission of its findings related to the two employees.
